messages:
maya-csm: Quick flag  Nimbus onboarding traffic spiked this morning. Can we do a 15-20m triage to lock a temporary budget gate and prepare a concise QBR appendix? :wave:
owen-finops: Confirmed in billing stream. Median tokens/day baseline ~500 -> spike to ~38k for the new cohort. If sustained, conservative add'l monthly spend ~ $4.2k. Suggest soft-cap + staged alerts, then evaluate batching/caching as cost sinks. :bar_chart:
liam-embed-ops: Two actionable levers today: (A) enable batching on the batch endpoint (low-risk toggle) -> estimated unit cost -18% for current payloads; (B) soft daily cap with exponential backoff response for clients. Longer-term: prefix-KV caching and model quantization.
sarah-qa: If we push a soft-cap, need exact error contract to test. Proposal: 429 + JSON body {"code":"soft_throttle","allowed_remaining":N} + header X-Soft-Throttle: true. I'll author test vectors for realtime and batch flows.
maya-csm: Proposed immediate config: daily_cap=45k; alerts at 60/85/95%; soft_throttle at 90% with one-click override for CSM+PS. Add an appendix slide with conservative/likely/upside spend scenarios and the mitigation timeline.
own-finops: Draft alert rule (simple text for eng): daily_cap=45000; thresholds_pct=[60,85,95]; notify=[maya-csm,owen-finops,alex-ps]; soft_throttle_pct=90; escalate_if>125%_for_3h -> pager. Can someone confirm feasible?
liam-embed-ops: Feasible. We'll implement soft_throttle behavior and gate behind feature flag. 429 body will include an ETA estimate when available; we can add X-Feature-Flag header. Batching toggle can be enabled immediately for Nimbus tenant on dedicated routing.
costbot: Policy created: nimbus-onboard-budget-watch-3167778888. Notifications: #customer-success + owen-finops@redwood.internal.
nora-customer: Thanks for the rapid turnaround. Please also enable batching on the batch-embed endpoint; that should smooth peaks while we tune caching. We'll assemble top-8 prompts + frequency and share by EOD.
alex-ps: For enablement workshop in QBR, can we include a short playbook for customers to handle soft-throttle? A one-slide consumer contract helps reduce support noise.
maya-csm: Good call. I'll add a one-slide consumer contract + short FAQ to the QBR appendix link: https://redwood.internal/qbrs/nimbus/appendix. Owen + Liam, please drop the conservative spend table and the test checklist there. Sarah, add the test vectors. Plan: close guardrail + appendix by Thursday so the QBR includes action items. :thumbsup:
